nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field with $q$ elements, let $f \in F[X]$, and let $n$ be the degree of $f$ (with $n = 0$ if $f = 0$). Let $\alpha$ be the class of $X$ in the quotient ring $F[X]/(f)$. Then $f$ is primitive if and only if $f$ is monic, $f$ is irreducible, and $\alpha$ is a primitive $(q^n - 1)$-th root of unity, that is, $\alpha^{q^n - 1} = 1$ and $q^n - 1$ divides every natural number $l$ with $\alpha^l = 1$.
nodes.title: Primitive polynomials via primitive roots of unity

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field with $q$ elements, let $f \in F[X]$, and let $n$ be the degree of $f$ (with $n = 0$ if $f = 0$). Then $f$ is primitive if and only if $f$ is monic, $f$ is irreducible, and the class of $X$ in the quotient ring $F[X]/(f)$ has multiplicative order $q^n - 1$.
nodes.title: Defining characterization of primitive polynomials

nodes.summary: Every primitive polynomial over a finite field is irreducible.
nodes.title: Primitive polynomials are irreducible

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field with $q$ elements, let $f \in F[X]$, and let $n$ be the degree of $f$ (with $n = 0$ if $f = 0$). Then $f$ is primitive if it is monic, it is irreducible, and the class of $X$ in the quotient ring $F[X]/(f)$ has multiplicative order $q^n - 1$.
nodes.title: Primitive polynomial over a finite field

nodes.summary: Every primitive polynomial over a finite field is monic.
nodes.title: Primitive polynomials are monic

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite field with $q$ elements and let $f \in F[X]$ be a primitive polynomial of degree $n$. Then the class of $X$ in the quotient ring $F[X]/(f)$ has multiplicative order $q^n - 1$.
nodes.title: Order of the root of a primitive polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $f$ be a polynomial over $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, and let $n$ be the degree of $f$ (with $n = 0$ if $f = 0$). Then $f$ is primitive if and only if $f$ is monic, $f$ is irreducible, and the class of $X$ in the quotient ring $(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})[X]/(f)$ has multiplicative order $p^n - 1$.
nodes.title: Primitive polynomials over $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
